name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux from PyPI through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc27): writes that succeeded stop being reported as unproven. After a write the server checks the result and tells you whether it was confirmed - and a bug meant some writes that HAD been fully checked were labelled unverified anyway, with a long note about how to investigate a failure that never happened. Building a company tree was the clearest case: every workgroup was confirmed against the database and you were still told nothing had been proven. Nothing was ever wrong with the data; the report about it was wrong, which is worse than it sounds because that label is the one worth reading. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
